The logic involves interacting with the VS Code UI (QuickPick, InputBoxes) and the built-in Git extension API. There are no network calls, no file system access to sensitive paths, no obfuscation, and no suspicious dependencies. The behavior is fully aligned with the extension's advertised purpose.
